Controls & keybindings
Select a category, then press 1–9 or 0 to choose a building. Click or drag to preview construction; release to place. Belts follow your path. Multi-tile buildings are spaced automatically. Blocked positions are skipped. Blue outlines indicate safe replacements; red outlines show blocked positions.
Middle-drag pans with any tool. With no tool, click a building to inspect or drag to pan. Scroll zooms. Arrow keys also pan. Escape or right-click cancels a preview or active tool. Inventory and palette collapse independently.
Underground: drag a straight line to preview tunnel pairs, or click entrance then exit 2–6 tiles ahead. Tunnels cross beneath obstacles. R / Shift + R rotate the chosen tool or inspected building; undirected structures ignore rotation.
Click a binding below and press a new key. Number keys are reserved for building slots. Duplicate bindings are rejected.
Grass, sand, gravel and stone support construction. Hills, mountains and water block both buildings and enemies. Miners extract ore or renewable sand. Enable enemies in Settings and supply turrets with physical ammunition.
